headline: Fund playback (incl. downloads) first and usability second, starting with songs that won't play and ad experience; billing/support is out of scope by leadership rule despite its late surge.

recommendations.rationale: PLY-WONTPLAY has a high priority score and high mean severity, though label agreement in the sample is weaker.
recommendations.title: Fix songs that won't play or play the wrong tracks

recommendations.rationale: USA-ADS is the largest usability issue, with a high complaint count and strong label agreement in the sample.
recommendations.title: Rework ad experience (frequency, length, loudness)

recommendations.rationale: USA-REDESIGN and PLY-GENERAL are specific, product-controlled issues that rank behind the top two.
recommendations.title: Address redesign regressions and playlist behaviour

recommendations.rationale: BIL-PAYWALL is large and surging, but pricing and plan structure are business decisions outside this quarter's product scope.
recommendations.title: Route billing/support surge to leadership
